name: @jfs/fetch-kit
description: Shared, dependency-free browser fetch and storage primitives for the JFS family of buildless static PWAs — the client twin of netlify-kit's fetchWithRetry (AbortController timeout, exponential backoff with jitter, typed HttpError/TimeoutError, in-flight request coalescing, a direct-first CORS proxy fallback chain, Retry-After parsing, multibyte-safe base64 codecs) plus the localStorage primitives absorbed from the retired @jfs/cache-kit (safe wrappers that never throw, JSON snapshots with TTL, quota-aware multi-key saves).
author: jsvolos63
